title: Deep link focus
preconditions: Know a seed species (+ optional exhibit), e.g. `African Lion` / Africa Savanna. URL-encode spaces as needed.

steps.name: Pan/focus target
steps.expect: Map pans/focuses toward the target marker.

steps.name: Tooltip or highlight
steps.expect: Tooltip and/or highlight on the focused animal.

steps.name: Query stripped
steps.do: Inspect the address bar after focus completes.
steps.expect: Focus query params removed via history replace.

steps.name: Refresh clean
steps.expect: Normal map load without forced focus.

steps.name: Invalid focus
steps.expect: Fails gracefully (no crash); map still usable.

steps.name: Bottom nav after focus
steps.do: Use bottom nav to Itinerary then back to Map.
